items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that is kind to dry, sensitive-looking skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a comfortable skin barrier and help dry skin look and feel more hydrated.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 whose iron oxides soften the look of redness while protecting skin from the sun.

response.routine_note: We left out the vitamin C serum and glycolic toner for now because strong acids can sting and make already red, sensitive-looking skin look worse; use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, with the SPF last in the morning. Since you say your face is always red, a dermatologist is the best person to look at it, and we would rather you book that visit than add more products.
